# Sanad native launch mark

Generated from `assets/images/sanad-logo.png` by `tools/generate_brand_assets.py`.
The launch mark is **96 × 96 points**, centered in the **whole screen**, with a
24-point corner radius and high-contrast background **#20508A**. These values match the first
Flutter frame. iOS displays the static launch image; Flutter continues with the
brand animation as soon as it presents its first frame.

Regenerate all platform sizes after changing the master logo. Do not manually
resize one asset and leave the other scales or Flutter metrics different.
